         MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN net_sales_eur END) AS sales_2024,
         MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN net_sales_eur END) AS sales_2025
  FROM sales_by_year
  GROUP BY store_id
),
growth_calc AS (
  SELECT store_id,
         (sales_2025 / NULLIF(sales_2024, 0)) - 1 AS growth_rate
  FROM sales_pivot
  WHERE sales_2024 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2025 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT store_id,
       growth_rate
FROM growth_calc
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC, store_id ASC
LIMIT 3
